documents.content: CharacterBody2D movement controller reads ui_left and ui_right, applies velocity, jump and move_and_slide.
Godot main scene contains the Player CharacterBody2D node and loads player.gd as an external script.
Inventory stores item stacks, crafting recipes and pickup events for collected resources.
The game workflow clarifies options, plans a task DAG, requests approval, executes waves and reviews failures.
MCP connector calls have bounded timeout, fallback attempts, side effect policy and retry audit records.
